meta.title: Restaurant ERP - Order to Invoice Process Flow (Built & Verified)
meta.subtitle: BOM/Semi-FG split, 2-counter billing, 2-level warehouse, GST + multi-currency + GSTR export, WhatsApp automation

views.label: Full Flow
views.note: Order se GSTR filing export tak pura built-and-verified flow — 12 detailed steps neeche cards mein, har ek ka real example ke saath

views.label: BOM & Kitchen Split
views.note: Confirm par BOM explode: Kitchen KOT (price nahi), Billing price, Inventory minus — Butter Chicken example cards 1-3

views.label: Warehouse & Stock Alerts
views.note: 2-level: Central -> Branch; dispatch sirf record, Receive hi real stock move karta — low stock alert cards 4-6

views.label: Billing, GST & WhatsApp
views.note: 2 Counter billing -> Multi-currency FX lock -> GST invoice (CGST/SGST/IGST) -> GSTR-1 HSN export -> WhatsApp Thank You — cards 7-11

views.label: WhatsApp Offer Campaign
views.note: Owner offer banata hai, WhatsApp batch broadcast REAL past customers ko — card 12

cards.title: 1. Order Capture — Waiter Tablet
items: Waiter apni tablet se table/takeaway chunta hai, menu se items add karta hai, phir Confirm Order dabata hai.
Example: Table T-12, Counter 1 — 2x Butter Chicken + 1x Garlic Naan add karke confirm kiya.

cards.title: 2. BOM Explode Engine — Dish ki Asli Recipe
items: Har dish ka BOM (Bill of Materials) recursive hai: ek dish Semi-FG (gravy/sauce/marinade) use kar sakti hai, jo khud raw material se banti hai.

Example: Butter Chicken = 1 unit Gravy (Semi-FG) + 200g Chicken. Gravy khud Tomato + Butter + Spices se banti hai — confirm karte hi system dono level ko explode karke saari real raw material quantity nikalta hai.

cards.title: 3. Kitchen KOT + Semi-FG Alert
items: Kitchen ko sirf item + qty wali ticket milti hai (KOT) — price nahi dikhti, taaki kitchen staff price se distract na ho.
Example: KOT par 'Butter Chicken x2, Garlic Naan x1' print hota hai. Agar Gravy ka batch stock minimum se neeche ho, kitchen ko turant 'prep now' alert bhi milta hai.

cards.title: 4. Central + Branch Warehouse
items: Owner ek Central warehouse (bulk stock) aur har branch ka apna local warehouse banata hai.
Example: Central se Branch B2 ko 50 kg Chicken dispatch hui — yeh sirf ek paper record hai, B2 ki actual stock abhi nahi badli.

cards.title: 5. Receive = Real Stock Move
items: Dispatch sirf record hai; jab branch 'Receive' confirm karti hai tabhi real inventory badalti hai.
Example: B2 ne 48 kg receive ki (50 mein se) — ab B2 ki inventory mein +48 kg aaya, aur 2 kg ka shortfall alag se record ho gaya (dhoka chhupaya nahi gaya).

cards.title: 6. Auto Stock Deduction + Low Stock Alert
items: Order confirm hote hi raw material + Semi-FG dono branch ki real inventory se minus hote hain. Stock kam ho to poora order reject ho jaata hai (kabhi aadha order nahi jaata).
Example: Chicken stock minimum 20 kg se neeche gaya to turant Purchase team ko Low Stock Alert milta hai — order karne se pehle hi pata chal jaata hai.

cards.title: 7. POS Receipt — 2 Billing Counters
items: Har branch mein 2 alag billing counters hote hain (Counter 1 aur Counter 2), dono independently same time par bill bana sakte hain — rush hours mein line nahi lagti.
Example: Counter 1 par dine-in customer ka bill, Counter 2 par ek saath takeaway customer ka bill — dono alag-alag chalte hain, koi conflict nahi.

cards.title: 8. GST Invoice — CGST/SGST/IGST Auto-Split
items: Ek hi company GSTIN, har branch invoice usi ke under. Same state ho to CGST+SGST aadha-aadha split hota hai; alag state ho to poora IGST lagta hai — HSN/SAC code bhi per item.
Example: ₹300 ka item 5% GST par — same state mein CGST ₹7.50 + SGST ₹7.50; agar customer dusre state ka ho to IGST ₹15.00 ek saath.

cards.title: 9. Multi-Currency — NRI/Export Billing
items: Foreign currency mein payment accept kar sakte ho; exchange rate SALE ke time lock hoti hai — baad mein rate badle to purana order kabhi nahi badalta. GST invoice hamesha INR mein hi rehta hai (legal requirement).
Example: ₹363.20 ka bill, customer ne USD mein pay kiya — receipt dikhati hai 'Payable in USD: $4.30 (rate ₹84.50 lock)'. Agar kal rate ₹85 ho jaaye, yeh purana bill nahi badlega.

cards.title: 10. GSTR-1 HSN Export — Filing Ready
items: Owner/Accountant date-range aur branch chunkar ek click mein HSN-wise GST summary CSV download kar sakte hain — GST portal ke offline tool mein seedha paste hoti hai.

Example: October ke 2 orders dono HSN 2106 @ 5% ke — export unhe ek row mein merge karta hai: Qty 3, Taxable ₹400, CGST ₹10 + SGST ₹10, Total ₹420. Jin branch ka GST setup nahi hua, unke orders alag se 'excluded' count mein dikhte hain — kabhi chhupaye nahi jaate.

cards.title: 11. WhatsApp Thank You Message
items: Order confirm hote hi customer ke WhatsApp par turant Thank You message jaata hai (agar number diya ho) — koi manual kaam nahi.
Example: 'Namaste Rahul! Aapka order #ORD-4821 confirm ho gaya — Total ₹420. Dhanyawad, phir se aaiyega! 🙏'

cards.title: 12. WhatsApp Offer Campaign
items: Owner naya offer banaye to ek click mein saare REAL customers ko WhatsApp par broadcast ho jaata hai — list fake nahi, sirf un logon ko jaate hai jinhone pehle order diya aur apna number diya.
Example: 'Saket Branch: 20% off all starters today! Valid tak 31 Oct' — 45 past customers ko ek saath bhej diya, sent/failed count turant dikhta hai.
